action_change: Explicit wait holds four simulation ticks (0.8s), no auto-fire; reload/projectiles continue. Legacy v1/v2 and raw input do not gain wait.

wait_admission.exceptions: Trapped tanks can wait. If the friendly-lane-safe roots contain no plan passing the wait gate, no_admissible_alternative is recorded and least-bad roots remain available. Not an optimality claim.

roles.recover: HP <=35, prioritize useful reachable repair; a lethal shot may still win the utility comparison.
roles.burst: Active power, favor prompt firing/range access over further stockpiling.
roles.assault: Shield >=12 with HP >35, lower route exposure cost and higher approach utility; still subject to actual-engine combat and friendly-fire forecasts.
roles.support: Unbuffed healthy teammate of a recovering/assault/burst tank, prioritize firing positions against enemies threatening that ally.

beneficial_wait_fixture: wait-check-2 after 20 actual-engine ticks of v3 continuation, side 0; search selects B1 wait, passes the +2 margin with no emergency fallback. Selected during development, not held out.

bounded_search_only_smoke.sides: Both use v3 search-only on shared snapshots
bounded_search_only_smoke.scope: Short integration smoke, not full matches or evidence that waits improve combat. All four stop at the predefined eight-round budget, without declaring winners.

boundary: Application heuristics and deterministic fixtures, not learned strategy, calibrated victory probabilities, global optimality, or held-out model quality evidence. Raw-map comparisons now differ in action space as well as input assistance. Same-revision search-only is the cleaner model-ranking ablation.
